decisions.decision: The Board agreed to review the articles on the Special Town Meeting warrant for the November 28, 2017 meeting to consider making recommendations at this time.
decisions.quote: board members agreed to review the articles presented on the special town meeting warrant for the november 28, 2017 meeting to consider making recommendations at this time.

decisions.decision: The Board would not vote on disposition of Articles 2 and 3 (firefighter and AFSCME collective bargaining agreements) at this time.
decisions.quote: it was determined that the board would not vote on disposition of these articles at this time.

decisions.decision: After a brief discussion, the motion on Article 5 (Wallis Park playground $25,000) was withdrawn, and the Board would not vote on approval of that article at this time.
decisions.quote: after a brief discussion, the motion was withdrawn and it was determined that the board would not vote on approval of this article at this time.
